card.name: Second digit inside numbers with units
card.fires_on: The second digit (often 0) of a two- or three-digit number, typically right before a unit such as lb, kg, mcg/mL or mm. It appears in dose, weight and size figures.

modes.label: Zero in a multi-digit number
modes.description: The digit 0 sits after a first digit in a figure like 30, 40 or 200 that is followed by a unit.
modes.example: A 2<<0>>0 mcg may provide additional asthma control

modes.label: Leading digit of a range
modes.description: The first digit of a range such as 10 to 20 in a concentration or weight.
modes.example: total phenytoin concentrations of <<1>>0 to 20 mcg/mL

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may help the model continue numbers followed by weight or size units.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number like 30 or 200 that is about to be followed by a unit such as lb, kg or mm.
